sentences.en: He claimed that the enormous property was at his disposal.
sentences.zh: 他声称那巨大的财产在他掌控之下。

sentences.en: No one knows how he has amassed his enormous fortune.
sentences.zh: 没人知道他是如何积累起如此庞大的财富的。

sentences.en: His son-in-law will be the heir to the enormous fortune.
sentences.zh: 他的女婿将是这笔巨大财富的继承人。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：e（出）+norm（规则）+ous（…的）→超出规范的→巨大的
